findings.description: The new explicit `params` parameter of `Session.get` is never forwarded to `self.request`. Because `params` is no longer part of `**kwargs`, it is silently dropped.
findings.rationale: Trigger: calling `session.get(url, params={'a': 1})`, or passing params positionally. Before the change, `params` travelled through `**kwargs` to `request`. Now it is captured by the named parameter and `request` is called without it. Impact: the query string is never sent, so users get wrong responses with no error.
